entities.summary: Qiwam al-Din al-Fath ibn Ali ibn Muhammad al-Bundari al-Isfahani, commonly known as Bundari (بنداري) or al-Bundari (البنداري‎), was an Iranian writer who is known for translating the Persian epic poem Shahnameh into Arabic.
